definitionZh: 切换替换 winky 格式 。 'off' (0) 保持更常规的字母形式,而'On' (1) 则保持 wonky 字母形式,如斜向根部在罗马语中,或斜向升起者在斜体中. 这些形式也由光学大小控制.
sourceDefinition: Toggle the substitution of wonky forms. 'Off' (0) maintains more conventional letterforms, while 'On' (1) maintains wonky letterforms, such as leaning stems in roman, or flagged ascenders in italic. These forms are also controlled by Optical Size.
